subject: Re: Post-call: Redwood integration & model routing - next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@acmeinc.com>, Sasha Kim <sasha.kim@acmeinc.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-01-31T15:00:00Z
Subject: Post-call recap & next steps — Redwood integration + model routing

Hi Alex / Sasha,

Thanks again for taking time today — great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side so we can keep momentum:

Call summary:
- Primary use case: customer support summarization + priority routing (live chat -> summarize -> rerank responses with embeddings for context).
- Scale: ~200k monthly requests, peak QPS ~15 during business hours.
- SLO goals: p95 latency <= 300ms for short-turn responses, lower-cost batch for embeddings jobs.

Integration & architecture notes:
- SDK: we recommend starting with the Redwood Node SDK (link in doc). Auth options: API key for POC; we discussed mTLS/KMS for prod (you flagged compliance requirements).
- Routing/policy: propose latency-first policy for live chat (route to low-latency hosted model variant in us-east, fallback to slightly higher-cost variant if cold/warming). Embeddings/rerank jobs should route to dedicated capacity in us-west for cost predictability.
- Structured output / tool calling: plan to enable function/tool calling for retrieval + structured summarize output (JSON schema).

Action items (owners & ETA):
1) Acme: confirm preferred auth for prod (API key vs mTLS/KMS) — Alex (by 2027-02-03)
2) Redwood: share integration checklist + model-routing proposal spreadsheet — Marissa (attached)
3) Dev/Infra: put together a short config snippet and staging test plan for routing policy + fallback chain — Dev (by 2027-02-04)
4) Schedule 30m technical POC to run sample traffic and validate latency & cost — Marissa / Alex (propose 2027-02-08)

Attachments: redwood-integration-checklist.pdf (high-level checklist), model-routing-proposal.xlsx (routing policy options, cost/latency estimates).

If that looks right, Alex — please confirm auth choice and I'll lock in a POC slot.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

---
Redwood Inference | Developer-first LLM inference platform

From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@acmeinc.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sasha Kim <sasha.kim@acmeinc.com>
Date: 2027-01-31T17:10:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & next steps

Thanks Marissa — this is great. Quick clarifications:
1) For the embeddings batch jobs, will deduping/context windows be handled by Redwood or do we need to preprocess?
2) For region routing, can we pin live chat to us-east only, and still run embeddings in us-west? Any cross-region egress we should budget for?

Also Sasha and I will discuss auth preference internally — aim to confirm by end of week.

Alex Turner
Director, ML Platforms | Acme, Inc.

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@acmeinc.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-02-01T08:45:00Z
Subject: Routing policy snippet + staging test plan

Hi Alex / team,

Following up with a quick config snippet and a short staging test plan as discussed. See inline snippet (Node SDK) and steps below.

-- config snippet (Node) --
const routingPolicy = {
  routes: [
    { name: 'live-latency', mode: 'latency_first', region: 'us-east-1', model: 'rw-llama-lowlat-v1' },
    { name: 'live-fallback', mode: 'fallback', region: 'us-east-1', model: 'rw-llama-cost-v1', onFailure: 'live-fallback' }
  ],
  embeddings: { region: 'us-west-2', capacity: 'dedicated' }
};

-- staging test plan --
1) Deploy routingPolicy to staging project + small dataset (10k records).
2) Run 1-minute p95 latency test at QPS=20 for live endpoint (measure cold vs warm).
3) Run embeddings job on dedicated pool and measure throughput/cost per 10k vectors.
4) Validate structured output via function/tool calling for summarize -> ensure JSON schema compliance.

Notes: cross-region egress is minimal for the patterns you outlined (requests originate in us-east, embeddings processed in us-west). We'll provide estimated egress cost in the model-routing-proposal spreadsheet attached.

I'll be available to run the POC on 2027-02-08 (suggest 10:00am PT).

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@acmeinc.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sasha Kim <sasha.kim@acmeinc.com>
Date: 2027-02-01T10:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & next steps

All good — thanks for the config and plan. Quick updates: 
- Auth: we'll go with API key for POC and plan KMS-based mTLS for prod (security team will follow up with specifics).
- POC: 2027-02-08 at 10:00am PT works for us. Please send calendar invite.
- Embeddings: we'll start with dedicated pool in us-west as recommended; Sasha will own the vector schema.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — looking forward to the POC.

Alex Turner
Director, ML Platforms | Acme, Inc.
